items.question: How many days does the Dubai International Holy Quran Award usually run during Ramadan?
items.gold: It usually runs for 20 days, starting at the beginning of the holy month.
items.fact: Dubai Holy Quran Award usually runs 20 days from Ramadan's start

items.question: How far away can the Firing the cannon (Midfa Al Iftar) tradition be heard in the UAE during Ramadan?
items.gold: It can be heard around 8-10 km away.
items.fact: Iftar cannon audible around 8-10 km away
